notes: Fee schedules per trading platform. Every profile is USER-PROVIDED unless 'verified_source' is set. Add a platform by copying a template below and filling in the user's actual schedule. The assistant never edits this file during a session.

fee_models.percent: fee = clamp(rate x order value, min, max) per order
fee_models.per_share: fee = clamp(per_share x shares, min, max_pct x order value) per order
fee_models.zero: no commission (spread, FX and regulatory fees may still apply)

bank-al-etihad-jo.name: Bank al Etihad (Jordan) app, US stocks

robinhood.name: Robinhood (Robinhood Financial, US), stocks and ETFs
robinhood.cash_interest: yes (uninvested cash sweep / Gold interest): flag purification when the Shariah screen is on
robinhood.order_types: limit and stop orders on US stocks and ETFs (confirm per ticker in the app)
robinhood.regulatory_fees_on_sells: SEC fee + FINRA TAF on sells only (cents on a typical order); covered by --friction-bps
robinhood.eligibility: US Robinhood accounts are for US residents; Robinhood UK/EU/SG are separate entities with FX fees
